Seed Capital

Back to quest database

Reach the planted-field and account-balance targets together.

Recorded build reference · 0.8.10.842 · configuration record, not individually play-tested

Work through the objectives

  1. Have at least 32 seeded plots.
  2. Have at least 10,500 C in your account.

Checks that can cause a stop

  • The balance check is a target, not a purchase cost or reward.
  • The field target counts seeded plots, not harvested crops or harvest income.
Failure conditions, recovery & continuation
Failure trigger
No quest-level failure trigger recorded
After failure
Restarts the current quest
